desc: Reduce the game state to the set of unvisited capacities and the total remaining delay-move pool.
Identify that the current parity-count criterion is incorrect.
Find counterexamples to the current criterion, including the failing public sample \(N=3,\ A=(1,9,2)\).
Derive the correct winner characterization from exact minimax.
Validate the characterization against all public samples and small-state analysis.
Prove the resulting winner criterion, including \(N=1\), \(N=2\), and mixed capacities.
Implement the corrected algorithm with stdin parsing and required output format.
Confirm complexity \(O(N)\) time and \(O(N)\) additional space aside from input storage.
